hardware: gfx1151 / Radeon 8060S (ZBook, thermally throttled; diagnostic). Final validation pending on gfx1151 desktop.
protocol: Back-to-back (not interleaved) fresh runs, reps/runs=3, 10 mtpbench prompts, 25 greedy outputs, each method vs its own concurrent true-AR. Lead accepts multiple back-to-back runs as sufficient for testing.
conclusion: MTP B3 remains the fastest: 17.54 tok/s (1.64x AR) vs EAGLE-4 n2 16.27 tok/s (1.44x AR). MTP leads in both absolute tok/s and ratio. The EAGLE two-stage parallel top-K (391ec1eea) closed EAGLE's gap from the original 0.78x to 1.44x but did not overtake MTP. Both AR-exact.
caveats: Back-to-back not interleaved; AR reference drifted slightly (MTP true_AR 10.67, EAGLE AR 11.30 tok/s) so cross-method ratios carry thermal noise; MTP ran in the slightly slower window yet still leads absolute. Aggregation differs (MTP weighted-over-prompts, EAGLE median-of-prompts). Diagnostic on throttled ZBook; final ranking to be confirmed on the gfx1151 desktop platform.
